cases.prompt: Make the part step by step. Overall size 40 x 12 x 30 mm. Step 1: sketch on the XZ plane (coordinates x, z in mm): outline through the points (0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 30), (0, 30), closed; inside (holes): circle with center (20, 15) and diameter 10. Extrude symmetrically, 6 mm to each side, new body.
cases.reference:
sk = new_sketch('XZ', offset=0)
polygon(sk, [(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 30), (0, 30)])
circle(sk, 20, 15, 10)
extrude(sk, 12, operation='new', symmetric=True)

cases.prompt: Make a disk 40 mm in diameter and 10 mm thick, centered on the XY plane: 5 mm above it and 5 mm below.

Make the part step by step. Overall size 21 x 21 x 47 mm. Step 1: sketch on the XY plane (coordinates x, y in mm): circle with center (0, 0) and diameter 21. Extrude symmetrically, 21 mm to each side, new body. Step 2: sketch on the XY plane offset z = -21 mm (coordinates x, y in mm): circle with center (0, 0) and diameter 11. cases.reference:
